notation.decision: Keep every EIA symbol nonnumeric; show its EIA meaning on screen and in Excel, retaining original symbol in Excel. Only numeric zero counts as reported zero. For status/chart a symbol counts as no value: all-symbol places get No data for these years and stay out of chart. Never convert a symbol to zero.
notation.additionalCheck: Report whether Bermuda, Greenland and Saint Pierre and Miquelon coal production values are numeric zeros or symbols.

documentedUSScope.decision: A route with no place filter counts for the US place kind only, when EIA documentation states the series covers the United States. Record the URL and quote in the route census. This amends the no place facet at country, US or state level reason for US scope only. Never use such a series for a state or a country.

explicitQualifiers.decision: Only existing lookup-list.json qualifiers crude oil and gasoline may have separate coverage cells. No new qualifiers. Count and report qualifier cells separately from the unchanged 672 whole-product cells. Use only when user words explicitly name that part. Label on screen, for example Gasoline (part of petroleum). Never use or offer a qualifier in place of the whole product.

yearBoundarySlots.decision: Start and end years are separate dialogue-state slots. A reply updates only stated year slots, preserving unstated slots. From X or since X states start only; use latest for end only when no end was already set. Stating both years, or a single year, replaces both. This supersedes the earlier whole-interval replacement rule.
yearBoundarySlots.D12: 2000-2019 then Japan and Korea, only from 2005 => 2005-2019
yearBoundarySlots.historicalEvidence: Keep earlier frozen files intact; record this as an owner-approved expectation change in the new freeze and explain affected earlier checks.

utilityScaleGeneration.decision: Prefer EIA total across all facility sizes (utility-scale plus small-scale) wherever EIA publishes one. Otherwise accept EIA utility-scale total as the whole product because it is EIA headline generation total.
utilityScaleGeneration.noticeCondition: EIA publishes a small-scale estimate for that fuel and place which the shown total omits.
utilityScaleGeneration.verificationRequired: Verify from EIA which fuels and places have small-scale generation estimates; record source.
utilityScaleGeneration.scope: Generation only. Does not make individual technologies, fuel components, sector subsets or facility capacities into whole-product totals. Existing schema/vocabulary and earlier frozen records remain unchanged.

headlineSectorGasPrices.decision: Accept EIA headline residential, commercial and industrial natural-gas price averages as whole-product prices in the named sector.
headlineSectorGasPrices.label: sales price; excludes gas transported for other sellers

rules: If EIA publishes a broader total for the same product, activity, place and sector, use the broader one.
Otherwise EIA own headline published figure counts as the whole product, labelled on screen with EIA own scope wording.
Subset only is reserved for a component of the product (one fuel type, one coal rank, crude-only for petroleum) or one sector when the user asked for all sectors.
standingScopeRule.application: Apply to all remaining scope cases without asking; list every case in checkpoint report for owner review. Ask only if a case fits none of these.
standingScopeRule.supersedes: Earlier research treated survey-population restrictions alone as subset-only, and limited the headline facility-size fallback to generation. This standing rule replaces that restriction; broader-total preference and exact scope labels remain required.
